name: open
instruction: Open Initial-text.json via the ordinary menu and real picker. Require editor AND actual three colored fixture objects.

name: blank-cancel
instruction: Select the actual Text toolbar control. Click observed canvas, leave blank, use Cancel/Escape. No new object/revision.

name: point-create
instruction: Ordinary Text click at an observed clear canvas location. Enter Native Text A; font Roboto-Regular; size20; color#123456; align left; Apply. Witness real glyphs.

name: point-edit
instruction: Choose the owner-discovered point UID in Native text block. Set Native Text B, Roboto-Bold, size24, color#224466; Apply.

name: undo-edit
instruction: Use ordinary Undo once. Point text/style must return to Native Text A/Regular20/#123456.

name: redo-edit
instruction: Use ordinary Redo once. Restore Native Text B/Bold24/#224466.

name: font-import
instruction: Open Fonts; choose bundled Roboto-Regular; Import bundled font. Read the actual new available asset ID and fingerprint; do not invent an ID or inject embedded bytes.

name: font-bind
instruction: Select the discovered point UID. In the ordinary Text font select choose the document font row with the exact admitted asset ID; Apply.

name: undo-font
instruction: Ordinary Undo restores bundled Roboto-Bold while preserving text/style/anchor and font inventory.

name: redo-font
instruction: Ordinary Redo restores the exact document asset font binding.

name: area-create
instruction: Ordinary Text drag a visible box in remaining canvas space; DOM draft Native area\nsecond line; size16; Roboto-Regular; color#336699; Apply or Ctrl/CmdEnter. Witness wrapping/position.

name: save-as
instruction: Ordinary Save As to new Saved-text.json. Wait for native saved acknowledgement; capture exact saved file.

name: replace-initial
instruction: Ordinary Open Initial-text.json again. Verify a fresh owner/presentation, no old text targets/font rows/editor draft.

name: reopen-saved
instruction: Ordinary Open Saved-text.json. Require both exact opaque native UIDs, text, optional-field presence and admitted font bytes/binding to survive.

name: edit-reopened
instruction: Select reopened point UID in actual native target dropdown. Set text Reopened Text C only; Apply. No duplicate native record.

name: undo-reopened
instruction: Ordinary Undo restores Native Text B with the exact asset font.

name: redo-reopened
instruction: Ordinary Redo restores Reopened Text C.

name: save-after
instruction: Ordinary Save As to new Saved-text-after.json. Validate full retained fixture semantics and exact two text/font records.

name: stale-read
instruction: Use the public read client with an earlier captured revision/snapshot (read-only). Require typed stale_revision, then fresh reads prove no state mutation.

name: locked-placement
instruction: Select visible locked F06-C if ordinary UI permits; Text placement must refuse without new draft/item/revision. Return to F06-A. Preserve an unavailable route as a failed/unavailable gate, never fabricate success.
